title: Best exercise and sights I've experienced in a while

title: DO THIS TOUR
text: Enrique is fantastic. Probably the best tour we’ve done, ever. Knowledgeable about everything! From local lore to history about BC. Answered a lot of questions. It’s a must-do tour for people who want to learn about the deep beautiful history of Barcelona and Catalonya. We were sad when we got to the tapas because that meant it was over!
author: adarC2805WW

title: Great tour!!!
text: Enrique was amazing! So much knowledge and information was shared. Incredibly knowledgeable, friendly, and great with extra questions.

title: Enrique was the best!

title: A wonderful visit!
text: Laura, the guide, was phenomenal! Interesting, expert in the subject, smiling, available for our questions and requests... Laura accompanied us through the beauties of the Gothic Quarter. She did not dwell on useless information, but on the contrary, she told us what is most beautiful and important to know about Barcelona. Top!
